originalTitle: Vita Coco Company, Inc. (COCO) Stock Dips While Market Gains: Key Facts
summary: In the latest trading session, Vita Coco Company, Inc. (COCO) closed at $55.97, marking a -1.82% move from the previous day.
content:
In the latest trading session, Vita Coco Company, Inc. (COCO) closed at $55.97, marking a -1.82% move from the previous day. This change lagged the S&P 500's 0.73% gain on the day. Elsewhere, the Dow gained 0.49%, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq added 1.19%.

Heading into today, shares of the company had gained 3.5% over the past month, outpacing the Consumer Staples sector's loss of 6.84% and the S&P 500's gain of 0.55%.

Investors will be eagerly watching for the performance of Vita Coco Company, Inc. in its upcoming earnings disclosure. It is anticipated that the company will report an EPS of $0.51, marking a 27.5% rise compared to the same quarter of the previous year. Meanwhile, our latest consensus estimate is calling for revenue of $233.73 million, up 28.2% from the prior-year quarter.

For the annual period, the Zacks Consensus Estimates anticipate earnings of $1.95 per share and a revenue of $802.63 million, signifying shifts of +63.87% and +31.63%, respectively, from the last year.

Additionally, investors should keep an eye on any recent revisions to analyst forecasts for Vita Coco Company, Inc. Such recent modifications usually signify the changing landscape of near-term business trends. Hence, positive alterations in estimates signify analyst optimism regarding the business and profitability.

Based on our research, we believe these estimate revisions are directly related to near-term stock moves. To exploit this, we've formed the Zacks Rank, a quantitative model that includes these estimate changes and presents a viable rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, stretching from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), has a noteworthy track record of outperforming, validated by third-party audits, with stocks rated #1 producing an average annual return of +25% since the year 1988. Within the past 30 days, our consensus EPS projection has moved 0.76% lower. Vita Coco Company, Inc. presently features a Zacks Rank of #4 (Sell).

With respect to valuation, Vita Coco Company, Inc. is currently being traded at a Forward P/E ratio of 29.27. This expresses a premium compared to the average Forward P/E of 17.27 of its industry.

One should further note that COCO currently holds a PEG ratio of 1.08. The PEG ratio is similar to the widely-used P/E ratio, but this metric also takes the company's expected earnings growth rate into account. As the market closed yesterday, the Beverages - Soft drinks industry was having an average PEG ratio of 1.66.

The Beverages - Soft drinks industry is part of the Consumer Staples sector. Currently, this industry holds a Zacks Industry Rank of 196, positioning it in the bottom 21% of all 250+ industries.

The Zacks Industry Rank assesses the strength of our separate industry groups by calculating the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks contained within the groups. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

chineseTitle: Vita Coco Company, Inc. (COCO) 股价下跌，而市场上涨：主要事实
chineseSummary: 在最新的交易日中，Vita Coco Company, Inc. (COCO) 收于 55.97 美元，较前一交易日上涨 -1.82%。
chineseContent:
在最新的交易日中，Vita Coco Company, Inc. (COCO) 收于 55.97 美元，较前一交易日上涨 -1.82%。这一变化落后于标准普尔 500 指数当日 0.73% 的涨幅。其他方面，道指上涨 0.49%，而以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上涨 1.19%。

截至今天，该公司股价在过去一个月上涨了 3.5%，超过了必需消费品板块 6.84% 的跌幅和标准普尔 500 指数 0.55% 的涨幅。

投资者将热切关注 Vita Coco Company, Inc. 在即将披露的财报中的表现。预计公司每股收益为0.51美元，较去年同期增长27.5%。与此同时，我们最新的共识预测收入为 2.3373 亿美元，比去年同期增长 28.2%。

对于年度期间，Zacks 一致估计预计每股收益为 1.95 美元，收入为 8.0263 亿美元，分别较去年增加 63.87% 和 +31.63%。

此外，投资者应关注最近对 Vita Coco Company, Inc. 分析师预测的任何修改。此类近期修改通常意味着近期业务趋势的变化。因此，预测的积极变化表明分析师对业务和盈利能力持乐观态度。

根据我们的研究，我们认为这些估计修正与近期股票走势直接相关。为了利用这一点，我们形成了 Zacks Rank，这是一个定量模型，其中包括这些估计变化并提供了一个可行的评级系统。

Zacks Rank 系统从#1（强力买入）延伸到#5（强力卖出），拥有值得关注的跑赢记录，经第三方审计验证，自 1988 年以来，排名#1 的股票产生的平均年回报率为 +25%。在过去 30 天内，我们的共识 EPS 预测下降了 0.76%。 Vita Coco Company, Inc. 目前的 Zacks 排名为#4（销售）。

就估值而言，Vita Coco Company, Inc. 目前的远期市盈率为 29.27。与行业平均远期市盈率 17.27 相比，这存在溢价。

还应该注意的是，COCO 目前的 PEG 比率为 1.08。 PEG比率与广泛使用的市盈率类似，但该指标也考虑了公司的预期盈利增长率。截至昨天收盘，饮料 - 软饮料行业的平均 PEG 率为 1.66。

饮料 - 软饮料行业是必需消费品行业的一部分。目前，该行业的 Zacks 行业排名为 196，在所有 250 多个行业中排名垫底 21%。

Zacks 行业排名通过计算各行业组中包含的个股的平均 Zacks 排名来评估我们各个行业组的实力。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
